memory_map.0xCBE8: VAR_SCORE_FINAL_BONUS_YOTZE - final bonus yotzee count, not including the first non-bonus yotzee
memory_map.0xCCCC: VAR_SUPER_YOTZEE_TOKEN_ACTI - state of the super yotzee token (in use or not)
memory_map.0xCBE2: VAR_SCORE_YOTZEE_BOOLEAN - state of whether player has a yotzee on the current turn
memory_map.0xCBD4: VAR_GAME_NO - overall game number of regular super slotzee
memory_map.0xCD4A: VAR_GAME_ACTIVE - tracks whether a game is active or not
memory_map.0xCCCE: VAR_REWIND_TOKEN_ACTIVE - tracks whether or not a rewind token is currently active
memory_map.0xCC0A: VAR_BONUS_EXTRA_ROLL - tracks whether the extra roll bonus (spinning 3 ONE slots) is active
memory_map.0xCBB6: VAR_TURN_NUMBER - tracks current turn number from 1-13
memory_map.0xCC4A: VAR_SCORE_FINAL_3OAK - the final score for 3 of a kind
memory_map.0xCC4C: VAR_SCORE_FINAL_4OAK - the final score for 4 of a kind
memory_map.0xCC4E: VAR_SCORE_FINAL_FULL_HOUSE - the final score for full house
memory_map.0xCC70: VAR_SCORE_FINAL_SM_STRAIGHT - the final score for small straight
memory_map.0xCC50: VAR_SCORE_FINAL_LG_STRAIGHT - the final score for large straight
memory_map.0xCC52: VAR_SCORE_FINAL_CHANCE - the final score for chance
memory_map.0xCBE6: VAR_SCORE_FINAL_YOTZEE - the final score for yotzee
memory_map.0xCB94: VAR_SLOT1RESULT - current state of slot 1 (1, 2, 3, or 4)
memory_map.0xCB96: VAR_SLOT2RESULT - current state of slot 2 (1, 2, 3, or 4)
memory_map.0xCB98: VAR_SLOT3RESULT - current state of slot 3 (1, 2, 3, or 4)
memory_map.0xCCDE: VAR_ENDGAME_TOKEN_DOUBLE_DO_0 - count of double down tokens used in current game
memory_map.0xCCE0: VAR_ENDGAME_TOKEN_ERASER_CO_0 - count of eraser tokens used in current game
memory_map.0xCCE2: VAR_ENDGAME_TOKEN_HEAVY_COU_0 - count of heavy tokens used in current game
memory_map.0xCCE4: VAR_ENDGAME_TOKEN_REWIND_CO_0 - count of rewind tokens used in current game
memory_map.0xCCE6: VAR_ENDGAME_TOKEN_SUPER_YOT_0 - count of super yotzee tokens used in current game
memory_map.0xCCE8: VAR_ENDGAME_TOKEN_WILD_COUN_0 - count of wild tokens used in current game
memory_map.0xCD9A: VAR_HIGH_SCORE_NEED_INITIAL - tracks what place on high score list user will need to enter initials for
memory_map.0xCD9C: VAR_HIGH_SCORE_CURRENT_INIT - tracks what initial is currently being entered into on the high score list
memory_map.0xCCEC: VAR_DOUBLE_DOWN_TOKEN_ACTIV - tracks whether or not a double down token is currently active
memory_map.0xCDBA: VAR_STATS_RUNNING_TOTAL_DOU - tracks how many times player played double down minigame
